thread:
arjun: Follow-up from the authz postmortem. We need to lock down action owners and realistic timelines. Root issues: intermittent refresh-token rejects, missing delete events in audit logs, and gaps in service-account secret rotation. Propose owners below.
emma: I'll own refresh-token validation and migration. Plan: reproduce failure modes, add stronger parsing + unit tests, and a migration that marks invalid persisted tokens. ETA 10d.
lucas: I'll take audit event coverage. Tasks: emit delete/service-secret lifecycle events, include actor/resource/action/result fields, and add dashboard with RBAC for the security team. ETA 5d.
nina: I'll handle secrets rotation runbook and canary key rollouts. Will document rollback, run KMS soak, and coordinate with infra. ETA 14d.
audit-bot: Created channel #sec-audit-notify and scaffolded basic alerts for missing delete events.
infra-bot: Noted potential regression: token serializer change in commit 3c4a1e. Recommend canary on staging before prod migration.
arjun: Also adding an automated monthly-spike regression test. This pattern repeats monthly; need detector + alerting.
emma: I'll add a load-pattern test and alert rule auth.unexpected_spike (10m window).
lucas: Dashboard will expose counts for audit.token.created, audit.token.deleted, and audit.token.refreshed. Will add retention verification steps.
nina: For rotation, proposing quarterly schedule for non-critical keys, monthly for high-risk service accounts. Canary plan: double-write new key for 24h and monitor auth error delta.
arjun: Action item summary (owner + ETA): - AUTH-9012 (emma)  refresh-token validation + migration  10d - AUD-9013 (lucas)  emit delete events + dashboard + RBAC  5d - SECR-117 (nina)  runbook + canary rotations  14d - TEST-451 (emma/infra)  monthly-spike regression test + alerting  7d
emma: Ack. Will attach repro and unit test checklist to the ticket tomorrow.
lucas: Ack. Dashboard link will be added to AUD-9013 when ready.
nina: Ack. Will schedule infra KMS soak and post run results.
arjun: I'll update the postmortem doc and add weekly progress check-ins (Tues 9am). Please update tickets with blockers and sliding ETAs.
emma: Adding fuzzing tests for malformed refresh formats. Example repro snippet:
```
ERROR auth: token validation failed: missing kid
payload: {"alg":"none","sub":"svc"}
```
lucas: For audit logs, will ensure both success and failure outcomes are stored and searchable. Also gating read access by sec-team role.
infra-bot: Staging canary scheduled 2026-05-04. Ensure migration flag toggles off by default.
arjun: Thanks team. Weekly syncs will keep progress visible.
